summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program for schools and libraries to ensure reliable broadband connectivity for modern education. The comment expresses opposition to limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, emphasizing its importance for providing connectivity to students and schools. The superintendent urges the Commission to protect the program to ensure schools can continue offering reliable, affordable connectivity.

claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools and libraries to build connectivity for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate would reduce funding for broadband infrastructure and connectivity in schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: I urge the Commission to protect E-Rate and ensure that public schools can continue providing students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.
